versions.changelog:
archive-intelligence 1.0.0

- Initial release of the archive-intelligence skill.
- Enables scheduled collection of the latest intelligence, policy updates, technical trends, and industry news for the archive sector.
- Supports one-time information queries and customizable regular intelligence gathering tasks.
- Provides standardized output formats for intelligence summaries and periodic reports.
- Includes curated lists of official, media, and academic information sources, as well as relevant keyword libraries.
- Offers clear configuration steps for both ad-hoc and scheduled information collection.
